title: exudyn.cUtilities: the time derivatives of the Euler parameter functions
author: Claude-JG
description: Decision D7 of revision2026c step RG11.10.1 (tmp/compareRBU.md, maintainer 2026-10-11: not now, an issue): RigidBodyMath has EP2RotationMatrix_t, EP_t2G_t and EP_t2Glocal_t, which neither rigidBodyUtilities nor exudyn.cUtilities offers; when wanted, add them to definitions/pybindCUtilities.py and PyCUtilities.h, with a check in cUtilitiesTest.py.
